correctness.rationale: Every nine-point E in F2^5 has affine rank at least 4. Full-rank affine configurations correspond via their augmented columns to even dimension-3 binary length-nine relation codes of minimum weight≥4. Their generator-column multiplicity vectors form exactly 11,440 weak compositions and 148 admissible vectors; GL(3,2) basis changes produce six classes. Independently reconstructed all six rank-5 representative dual-code Walsh histograms and exact stabilizer orbit sizes, matching 27,339,520 labeled sets, including the (15,13,3,0,1) duplicate with orbit sizes 6,666,240 and 2,222,080. Independently enumerated all 11,440 nine-subsets in F2^4 under translations and elementary linear shears, finding rank-4 orbits 240,6,720,4,480 and 62 unique affine hyperplanes. Total 27,339,520+62*11,440=28,048,800=binomial(32,9). The original verifier independently checks direct Walsh sample histograms against relation dual weights and all six rank-5 code classes; the proof reduces to these complete finite sets. Different column-multiplicity multisets prove the two classes inequivalent.
